data.name: Rajnarayan
data.gender_notes: Rajnarayan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: King of Kings, Lord of Gods
data.long_meaning: Raj (King) + Narayan (God) = King of Gods, Lord of the Universe. The name Rajnarayan carries the meaning “King of Kings, Lord of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rajnarayan usually hope their child will grow to embody king of kings, lord of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine ruler, the one who governs both the material and spiritual world
data.etymology: Rajnarayan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Kings, Lord of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajnarayan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rajnarayan holds great cultural significance in Hinduism, representing the idea of a divine monarch who rules over the universe. This name has been used for several deities and also for royal figures.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rajnarayan signifies the presence of God (Narayan) within an individual, making them a king (Raj) in the spiritual realm. The understanding is that each soul is a microcosm of the universe and contains the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rajnarayan: King of Gods (Raja - king, Narayan - God). Symbolizes the pursuit of divine kingship in one's life, embodying both worldly power and spiritual enlightenment.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Lakshmi Rajnarayan in Bali, Indonesia attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Rajnarayan, which means "King of Kings, Lord of Gods". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
